remaining_core: The general Hambly-Lyons direction from trivial signature to a geometric tree-height witness, and the two-path equivalence connection, remain open. The opposite direction for all finite-dimensional continuous BV paths is proved by actual finite sampling and a verified uniform BV limit.
counting_convention: Named theorem/lemma/def/abbrev declarations indexed by the existing common verifier; structures and instances are not included in these counts.
